_doc: Where the player discards a filled condom they took off themselves (SingleUseEquipUtility.DiscardFilled, Docs/Interactions/Step06FPermissionsImplementationPlan.md P5b). Code-launched, queued; self = the player. Code fills StoredOptions[discardOptions] with one option per body part of every character the condom's organ last touched (event_OnCondomDiscard_onPart), AppendStrings[item] = the condom's name, and FunctionCalls[discard] = move it from the player's inventory to the room floor. Picking a body part first pours half of each semen in the condom onto it as a trace_cum body trace (SingleUseEquipUtility.PourOntoPart, Docs/Body/Plan_BodyTraces.md 5.4), then drops the condom with the other half; parts that can't hold traces are listed disabled (event_OnCondomDiscard_noTrace). Without a partner, or for anyone else, code drops it on the floor without this event.
